text: The Winline bookmaker belongs to OOO Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS (UK NKS); its largest shareholder, Andrey Myslivtsev, holds 45%.

source.name: Stavka.tv — Vinлайн: кто основатель и владелец (Winline: who is the founder and owner)
source.quote: Компания входит в ООО «Управляющая компания НКС» с уставным капиталов 120 миллионов рублей. Основной долей владеет Андрей Мысливцев.
source.note: Russian; translation: 'The company is part of OOO Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS with charter capital of 120 million roubles. The main share is held by Andrey Myslivtsev.' The same page states management of the bookmaker passed to OOO 'Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya Natsionalnogo konevodcheskogo soyuza' and lists shareholders: Myslivtsev 45%, Egorchenko 20%, R. Yusupov 16%, Grishkin 15%, L. Yusupova 4%; it also lists HC Traktor among the clubs Winline partners with in 2026.
